REPLAY FIXTURE — the one real G-number collision in this repository's history.

Side: `origin/main` at the time — parent 2 of merge `1a919485`
Commit: 7f3aa24b
Rows: 185

REDUCTION, stated so nobody mistakes this for the file itself. Every '| G<n> |'
row of docs/HANDOFF.md at that commit is reproduced here with its ruling number
verbatim and its cell text replaced by the first 32 hex of the sha256 of the
WHOLE original row line. findTrunkCollisions() reads exactly two things from a
row -- its number, and whether its text is byte-identical to another row's -- and
the digest preserves both relations exactly while turning 230 KB of prose into
7 KB. Regenerate and diff:

  git show 7f3aa24b:docs/HANDOFF.md \
    | awk '/^[[:space:]]*```/{f=!f; next} f{next} /^\| G[0-9]+ \|/{ print }' \
    | while IFS= read -r l; do \
        n=$(printf '%s' "$l" | sed -E 's/^\| G([0-9]+) \|.*/\1/'); \
        d=$(printf '%s' "$l" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-32); \
        printf '| G%s | %s |\n' "$n" "$d"; \
      done
-->
